title: seq-triage samplesheet
description: One row per sample. Hard rules only: anything unambiguously wrong in a single row. Cross-row and soft checks run later in the R metadata screen.

sample.errorMessage: Sample ID must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' (it becomes part of output file names).

fastq_1.errorMessage: fastq_1 must be a gzipped FASTQ (.fastq.gz or .fq.gz) with no spaces in the path.

fastq_2.errorMessage: fastq_2 must be a gzipped FASTQ (.fastq.gz or .fq.gz) with no spaces in the path. Leave it blank for single-end or ONT data.

platform.errorMessage: platform must be illumina or ont (nanopore is also accepted; case does not matter). Leave it blank to have the platform detected.

sample_type.errorMessage: sample_type must be isolate, metagenome, amplicon or unknown (case does not matter), or left blank.

molecule.errorMessage: molecule must be dna or rna (case does not matter), or left blank. Use rna for RNA-seq, metatranscriptomes and direct RNA, even when the reads are cDNA.
